title: Scalable Finite Adaptability via Polyhedral Partition and Learning
summary: We study finite adaptability for decision-making under uncertainty, where a small set of candidate solutions is prepared in advance and the best response is selected after uncertainty is realized. While existing methods have made significant progress on exact formulations, scalability remains a persistent challenge due to (i) the combinatorial nature of assigning decisions to uncertainty realizations, and (ii) the joint optimization of uncertainty set partition and subsequent decisions.
